snippet.description:

Afterwards, you can call an animation block with layoutIfNeeded to begin animating to the new properties.

Animating with constraints is especially useful to maintain view locations without having to recalculate CGRect values. Have fun.

snippet.title: How to use Xcode Shortcuts to Speed Up your Development Process
snippet.description:
In today's video, I'm going to go through many of the shortcut keys I use in my everyday app development process.  There are quite a few shortcuts that I didn't go over in the video but here are the ones I mentioned:

Xcode
CMD + /: Comment out multiple lines at a time
CMD + [ ]: Change spacing indents of multiple lines

CMD + SHIFT + O: Open Quickly with file name
CMD + CTRL + LEFT/RIGHT: Go to Previous or Next file

CTRL + 6: List out file functions

CMD + CTRL + E: Refactor variable name

CMD + 1: Project Explorer
CMD + 3: Global Search
CMD + SHIFT + F: Quick access to Global Search
CMD + 0: Hide Project Explorer
CMD + OPTION + 0: Hide Documentation/Utilities Toolbar

CMD + B: Compile
CMD + R: Compile and Run project
CMD + . : Stop Compile
CMD + SHIFT + K: Clean Project

Simulator
CMD + 1/2/3: Resize simulator
CMD + K: Show physical keyboard
CMD + RIGHT/LEFT: Rotate device

snippet.title: 10 Reasons Why I Abandoned Storyboards and Interface Builder
snippet.description:
Quick break from all the coding today. In today's video I'll list out my top 10 reasons why I don't use storyboards.  Let the flame begin...

10. Difficulty in laying out views that are stacked
9. IBOutlet & IBAction crashes when refactoring
8. Cell Identifiers and Storyboard Id strings are unsafe
7. Compile time for complicated storyboards increases
6. Refactoring all fonts in Storyboard components take too long
5. Productivity decrease when hands leave the keyboard
4. Screen size on laptop too small for storyboards
3. Difficult to record and explain things on storyboard
2. Teaching beginner iOS programmers what is exactly going on is difficult with storyboards.
1. Merge conflicts will drive you crazy.

Hope everyone enjoys my short list of why I prefer not to use storyboards.  I'm ready for the flame down in the comments.

snippet.title: iOS Swift: Build UICollectionView programmatically without Storyboards
snippet.description:
In this tutorial video, we'll go over step-by-step how to build a UICollectionView in pure code without using Storyboards.  

First we'll remove the Main.storyboard file, fix compile and run-time errors. Next we use a subclass of UICollectionViewController as our root view controller. We then implement the necessary UICollectionViewDatasource and Delegate methods to render a few cells.  Finally, we set our text in each of those cells from an array of Strings.
